title: Natural Disaster
description: a mod that adds natural disasters to your minecraft world.
body:
![showcase of tsunami](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11119a4896869e465f3d97ef05f68afd0911fd7f.jpeg)Natural Disasters Mod

Experience a more dynamic and challenging Minecraft world with the Natural Disasters Mod. This mod introduces a variety of realistic natural disasters that can occur randomly throughout your gameplay, forcing players to adapt, prepare, and survive.

Features
Tornadoes that can damage terrain and structures.
Volcanic eruptions that spread lava and cause destruction.
Tsunamis that flood coastal areas and low-lying terrain.
Powerful thunderstorms with frequent lightning strikes.
Earthquakes that shake the ground and affect the environment.
Blizzards and extreme weather conditions that impact survival.
Configuration etc.

The frequency, intensity, and behavior of disasters can be customized to match your preferred playstyle, from occasional environmental events to a constant survival challenge.

Compatibility

Designed to work alongside most Minecraft modpacks.
